## Account Invitation System in Jumpstart Pro

The invitation functionality is fully implemented. Here's a summary:

### Where to Find It

| Component | Location |
|-----------|----------|
| Model | [account_invitation.rb](app/models/account_invitation.rb) |
| Admin Controller | [accounts/account_invitations_controller.rb](app/controllers/accounts/account_invitations_controller.rb) |
| Accept/Decline Controller | [account_invitations_controller.rb](app/controllers/account_invitations_controller.rb) |
| Mailer | [account_invitations_mailer.rb](app/mailers/account_invitations_mailer.rb) |
| Routes | [routes/accounts.rb](config/routes/accounts.rb) |
| Views | [app/views/accounts/account_invitations/](app/views/accounts/account_invitations/) |

### How It Works

1. **Admin invites someone** via `/accounts/:id/invitations/new` - enters name, email, and role (admin/member)

2. **System sends email** with a secure token link to `/account_invitations/:token`

3. **Invitee clicks link**:
   - If logged in → sees accept/decline page
   - If not logged in → redirected to sign up with `?invite=:token` (pre-fills name/email)

4. **On accept** → Creates `AccountUser` record linking them to the account with the specified roles

### Accessing It in the UI

The invite link should appear on the account team/members page. Look at:
- [app/views/account_users/index.html.erb](app/views/account_users/index.html.erb) - Team members list
- There should be an "Invite" or "Add Member" button linking to `new_account_account_invitation_path(current_account)`

### Key Routes

```
GET  /accounts/:account_id/invitations/new    # Create invitation form
POST /accounts/:account_id/invitations        # Send invitation
GET  /account_invitations/:token              # Accept/decline page
PUT  /account_invitations/:token              # Accept
DELETE /account_invitations/:token            # Decline
```
